The '''''Perihelion''''' was a space [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]] that was owned by [[Cularin Star Tours]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was hired to the [[Liana Liberators]], who were posing as members of the [[Alderaanian Biological Research Institute]] and planned to [[Slicer/Legends|slice]] into important computer systems in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] from it. However, it was attacked by mynocks, although the CST safety ship ''[[Starchaser IV]]'' was able to rescue it. Afterwards, the Liberators flew it to [[CMC-3]] in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]], where it participated in a battle against the ''Starchaser'' and a [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunter]] flown by [[Shiana Trist]].
